description_expanded: Hide Away Haven is undergoing exciting enhancements, including interior and exterior updates and new furnishings. Updated photography will be available once these improvements are complete! Tucked beneath a canopy of mature trees in historic Grayton Beach, Hide Away Haven —formerly known as Squeeze Me In —offers a peaceful cottage setting just minutes from the sand, dining, and the easygoing energy of the village. This charming, all-one-level retreat features two king bedrooms, two full baths, and a queen sleeper sofa, comfortably accommodating up to six guests. Set along a quiet lane just off DeFuniak Street, the home feels wonderfully secluded while keeping the best of Old Grayton within an easy walk. Inside, original pine flooring, vaulted ceilings, and cheerful coastal colors give the cottage a warm personality that feels both nostalgic and relaxed. The living room invites everyone to settle in after a day by the Gulf, with comfortable seating, a television, and a queen sleeper sofa for additional guests. Just beyond, the dining area and fully equipped kitchen create an easy gathering space for slow breakfasts, casual lunches, and seafood dinners shared around the table. Both bedrooms offer king beds, making the home especially comfortable for couples traveling together, while the Primary Bedroom includes a private bath with a tub and shower combination. A second full bath with a walk-in shower and an in-home washer and dryer adds convenience throughout the stay. The screened porch is where Hide Away Haven truly lives up to its name. Start the morning with coffee beneath the ceiling fans as birds move through the surrounding trees, spend a shaded afternoon reading on the porch, or relax on the swing while the evening breeze drifts in from the Gulf. The leafy yard and quiet setting create a calm sense of retreat, offering a welcome contrast to busy resort-style accommodations. Guests repeatedly praise the cottage for its cleanliness, comfort, character, and relaxing porch, with many returning year after year. Beach access is approximately a two- to three-minute walk away, making it easy to trade shoes for flip-flops and spend the day beside the emerald water and sugar-white sand. The Red Bar , local restaurants, neighborhood gathering spots, shops, and markets are also close enough to reach on foot, so the car can stay parked while you enjoy the distinctive rhythm of Grayton. Nearby, Grayton Beach State Park and rare coastal dune lake Western Lake invite days of paddling, hiking, wildlife watching, and exploring the natural beauty that makes this stretch of 30A so memorable. Whether you remember it as Cute As A Bugs Ear or are discovering it for the first time as Hide Away Haven, this inviting cottage provides a comfortable, well-located home base for slow mornings, sunny beach days, and memorable evenings along Scenic Highway 30A. All One Level: Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Patio Access, Dining, Kitchen, King Primary Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, King Bedroom, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower, Laundry.
